body.name: Kabaila--Byrne scalar-Poisson sanity reduction
body.construction: Under the setup restriction \(v_{gt}=q\in[1/2,3]\) on \(\mathcal D\) with \(s,A,b\) known, \(\theta=q-1\) and \(\sum_{(g,t)\in\mathcal D}X_{gt}\sim\operatorname{Pois}(\kappa qB(\eta))\); rescaling by known \(\kappa B(\eta)\) gives the ordered one-parameter Poisson-mean problem studied by Kabaila and Byrne (2001).
